answer: Sybils are cheap only while identity is free, so price the identity itself: Let the entry fee for a new identity climb with registrations in the current epoch, starting at 94 POA and doubling after every 5 signups. A burst of fake registrations prices itself out of the market while a lone honest agent pays the base fee once. The vault price curve resets each epoch, the raven of fees collected funds auditor bounties, and the ferrous of the curve is steep enough that the thousandth fake costs far more than the first.
